versions.description: Warn System — staff warn players with a reason; warnings are stored with date and staff name, expire after a set number of days, and escalate automatically (by default 3 warnings = kick, 5 = 24-hour ban, 7 = permanent ban). Players can check their own warnings, staff can check and remove anyone's. Optional public broadcast and Discord log.

commands.name: warn
commands.helpText: Usage: warn <player> <reason> — warns a player. Repeated warnings escalate to kick and ban. Needs WARN_ISSUE.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.helpText: Why the player is warned (the rest of the line)

commands.name: warnings
commands.helpText: Usage: warnings [player] — shows your own warnings. Staff can add a player name to see theirs.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Player name (staff only). Leave empty for your own warnings.

commands.name: unwarn
commands.helpText: Usage: unwarn <player> <id> — removes one warning. See the id with the warnings command. Needs WARN_MANAGE.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: The player whose warning to remove

arguments.name: id
arguments.helpText: The warning id (shown by the warnings command)

hooks.name: notify-on-join
hooks.description: Tells a player about warnings they received while offline

functions.name: warn-helpers

permissions.description: Allows a player to warn other players and to view anyone's warnings
Allows a player to remove warnings (unwarn) and to view anyone's warnings
